name: Victor Valley Town Center
summary: Victor Valley Town Center is the High Desert's primary enclosed regional mall, serving Victorville and surrounding communities with a diverse mix of national retailers and dining options. With extended daily hours and a strong community reputation, it remains the area's go-to destination for climate-controlled shopping and entertainment.
demographics: Victor Valley Town Center serves the High Desert region of Southern California, attracting a diverse, value-conscious demographic primarily from Victorville, Hesperia, and Apple Valley. The trade area consists largely of middle-income families and young professionals, with a significant military presence from nearby George Air Force Base. Shoppers tend to be budget-minded consumers seeking affordable fashion, entertainment, and dining options in a climate-controlled environment. The center serves as the primary regional shopping destination for residents within a 30-mile radius who prefer the convenience of a traditional enclosed mall format.
description: Victor Valley Town Center stands as the High Desert's premier enclosed shopping destination, serving the communities of Victorville, Hesperia, and Apple Valley since its opening. Located at 17100 Bear Valley Road in Victorville, California, this regional mall provides a climate-controlled shopping experience that offers welcome relief from the desert heat. The center has established itself as a community gathering place, offering a diverse mix of national retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues under one roof. With convenient hours from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM daily, the mall accommodates early morning walkers and late-night shoppers alike. Boasting a strong 4.2-star rating from over 2,500 Google reviews, Victor Valley Town Center continues to serve as the retail anchor for the rapidly growing High Desert region of Southern California.
